case.question: Is the shirt black or yellow?

prompt:
USER: <image>
Is the shirt black or yellow?
Answer with exactly one of: Black, Yellow. Do not add punctuation or explanation. ASSISTANT:
metric: sum log P(all annotated answer pieces|fixed prompt and answer prefix); no EOS
intervention: RGB(128,128,128) blank-source residual replacement into real-image receiver; all later computation recomputes

approximate.scope: receiver gradient times donor-minus-receiver at post-block residual sites
approximate.arithmetic: native BF16 activation differences and gradients; token scores exported in FP32
